items.content_html: MoveIt is a modern, lightweight desktop application that prevents your computer from going to sleep by intelligently moving your mouse cursor at specified intervals. items.content_html: AWEFX( Automation WorkFlow Engine Experiment ) is an open-source, lightweight automation engine that lets you build visual workflows and orchestrate custom functions like an alternative to n8n.
